, a family-owned remodeling company based at 31 Essex Drive in Hauppauge, is now scheduling basement remodeling projects through the winter months for local homeowners.

Basement projects suit the colder season well. The work happens inside the house, so snow and freezing temperatures rarely cause delays. Many homes in the area have unfinished or partly finished basements used mostly for storage, and that square footage can become a family room, home office or guest suite.

"Winter is when families feel how tight the house has gotten," said Mike Meigel of Meigel Home Improvements. "A finished basement gives everyone room to spread out, and it is a project our crews can keep moving on the coldest days of the year."
